items.quote: We continue to maintain our guidance of keeping credit costs below 25 bps on a sustainable basis.
items.statement: Credit costs below 25 bps on a sustainable basis
items.speaker: Sachinder Bhinder

items.quote: we are targeting around 25%+ growth in disbursements in FY27
items.statement: Disbursement growth of 25% or more in FY27
items.speaker: Sachinder Bhinder

items.quote: But roughly, we are confident to have 5.25% spread by the year end.
items.statement: Spread of about 5.25% by FY26 year end
items.speaker: Ghanshyam Rawat

items.quote: we are confident of exceeding that level comfortably this year as well
items.statement: Q4FY26 disbursements to exceed Rs 20 bn

items.quote: We are confident that 20 basis point credit costs across, I think in the next couple of years
